## Professional Summary

Ridham Pokiya is an Indian DevOps and Cloud Engineer who specialises in AWS serverless architectures, automated CI/CD pipelines, SaaS product development, and ERP systems. He has completed 3+ internships, earned 20+ technical certifications, and founded two SaaS companies: Heeratrack (Diamond ERP) and Validexio (Startup Validation Platform). He is an AWS Student Builder Core Member at Parul University (PPSU) in Gujarat, India.

---

## Companies Founded

### Heeratrack
- **URL**: https://www.heeratrack.com
- **Type**: Multi-tenant SaaS ERP platform
- **Industry**: Diamond industry / B2B
- **Description**: Heeratrack is a premium Diamond Business Management and ERP SaaS platform built for diamond merchants and manufacturers. It manages workers, salaries, chalans (invoices), real-time production tracking, and inventory management. Heeratrack digitises and modernises the operational backbone of diamond factories in India.
- **Technologies**: SaaS, ERP, Web App, Real-time, Multi-tenant
- **Market**: Indian diamond industry (centred in Gujarat and Surat)

### Validexio
- **URL**: https://validexio.com
- **Type**: Startup idea validation SaaS platform
- **Industry**: Startup ecosystem / Market Research / AI
- **Description**: Validexio is a real-time startup idea validation platform that replaces stale market research PDFs with live competitor data, real-time market sizing, and actionable insights. It helps founders validate business ideas with real signals instead of guesswork or armchair entrepreneurship. Philosophy: execution over speculation.
- **Technologies**: React, Node.js, Live Data Fetch, PostgreSQL, Stripe, AWS, Railway
- **Market**: Global startup founders and early-stage entrepreneurs
